name: Global fiducial Ø1.0 mm, 2.0 mm opening
description: A global fiducial: a Ø1.0 mm bare copper dot in a Ø2.0 mm solder mask opening, the clear area the opening.

citation.document: JLCPCB Help Center, How to Add Edge Rails and Fiducials for PCB Assembly Orders (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/how-to-add-edge-rails-fiducials-for-pcb-assembly-order, read 2026-11-21)

note: JLCPCB: "The recommended diameter of a fiducial marker is 1 mm." and "The solder mask opening should be twice the diameter of the exposed copper pad." The clear area is the opening: "This area should be equal in size to the solder mask clearance (e.g., 2.0 mm in diameter)." (JLCPCB blog, Fiducial Marks in PCB and SMT Assembly (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/fiducial-marks, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21)).

name: Global fiducial Ø1.0 mm, 2.0 mm opening, both sides
description: The Ø1.0 mm global fiducial with a second dot opposite it on the far side, for boards assembled on both sides.

citation.document: JLCPCB Help Center, How to Add Edge Rails and Fiducials for PCB Assembly Orders (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/how-to-add-edge-rails-fiducials-for-pcb-assembly-order, read 2026-11-21)

note: Sizes as the 1.0 mm preset (JLCPCB). Both sides: "For a double-sided SMT assembly, you must have a set of global fiducials on both the top and bottom sides of the board." (JLCPCB blog, Fiducial Marks in PCB and SMT Assembly (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/fiducial-marks, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21)).

name: Global fiducial Ø1.0 mm, 3.0 mm clear area
description: A global fiducial: a Ø1.0 mm bare copper dot in a Ø3.0 mm solder mask opening and clear area (three times the dot's radius).

citation.document: PCBWay, Design Instruction: PCB Panelization, Breakaway Rails, Fiducial Marks, Tooling Holes (https://pcbway.com/helpcenter/design_instruction/PCB_Panelization__Breakaway_Rails__Fiducial_Marks__Tooling_Holes.html, read 2026-11-21)

note: PCBWay: "The minimum diameter of a fiducial mark is 1.0mm, and the maximum diameter is 3.0mm."; a clear area "with a minimum radius of 2R", and "If a radius of 3R can be achieved, the machine recognition will be better"; "If soldermask is used, it should not cover the clear area", so the opening is the clear area.

name: Local fiducial Ø1.0 mm, 2.0 mm opening
description: A local fiducial for a fine-pitch part (0.5 mm pitch or less), placed in pairs diagonally across its land pattern: a Ø1.0 mm dot in a Ø2.0 mm opening and clear area.

citation.document: JLCPCB Help Center, How to Add Edge Rails and Fiducials for PCB Assembly Orders (https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/how-to-add-edge-rails-fiducials-for-pcb-assembly-order, read 2026-11-21)

note: Neither JLCPCB nor PCBWay gives local fiducials sizes of their own, so this is the global fiducial's size (JLCPCB's 1 mm dot in a 2 mm opening; PCBWay's smallest mark, 1.0 mm). When to use one: local fiducials are for fine-pitch components, "specifically those with a pitch of 0.5mm or less", and "Typically, two fiducial marks are placed diagonally opposite the component's land pattern." (JLCPCB blog, Fiducial Marks in PCB and SMT Assembly (https://jlcpcb.com/blog/fiducial-marks, updated 2026-09-09, read 2026-11-21)).
